type Attestation struct
  By string
  Verified bool
  Hop int64
  Program string
  Host string
  User string
  Exe string
  UID int64
  GID int64
  PID int64
  Key string
  Mac string
type Record struct
  Schema int64
  Time string
  Level int64
  Msg string
  Identity []Attestation
  Job string
  Attrs map[string]string
type Page struct
  Outcome PageOutcome
  Records []Record
  Next string
  AtEnd bool
type HistoryUsage struct
  RetainedBytes int64
  Oldest string
  MaxUse *int64
  MaxRetentionMs *int64

  Outcome HistoryUsageOutcome

  Selection ApplicationLogSelection
  Program string

  Program string
  CapturedFileKey string

  Outcome HistoryPageOutcome

  AtEnd bool
type SourceDescriptor struct
  ID string
  Availability SourceAvailability
  Limitations []SourceLimitation
type SourceCatalog struct
  Sources []SourceDescriptor
  Outcome SourceCatalogOutcome
type ProducerClaim struct
  Provider string

  UID int64
  GID int64

  SourceID string

  Outcome HistoryPageOutcome

  Next string
  AtEnd bool

  RetryAfterMs int64

  Value EndpointDescription
